content:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: high HTTP 5xx error-rate on ingress-gateway-prod. Rule: rolling 2m 5xx_rate > 4%. current: 7.9% :rotating_light:
pagerduty-bot: Incident PD-50902 created, policy=oncall-sre. Paging primary @alex and secondary @maria. Escalation in 3m if unacked.
alex: acked in PD. starting triage  checking region breakdown.
maria: dashboards show spike concentrated in eu-west1 and eu-west2, ingress error_class=502/503 mostly.
devon: I saw a config rollout from infra-cfg-manager at 03:02 UTC that touched ingress-rate-limiter. Could be it. Pulling the config diff.
ops-bot: config-diff for change 2026-03-15T03:02Z: `max_conn_per_host: 300 -> 30` and `conn_timeout_ms: 500 -> 50` (automated rollout).
alex: that looks suspicious. 50ms timeout seems too low. Are we getting connection resets? grabbing proxy logs.
maria: support reports a handful of affected customers in EU SRE queue. CS tagging high-touch customers.
devon: reproducing logs: many `upstream connect timed out` and `503 no healthy upstream`. Sidecar metrics show connection saturation. The limiter change essentially choked backend connections. Rolling back the config now.
alex: while rollback proceeds, doing quick mitigation: divert EU traffic to dedicated-pool and increase backend replicas. Command: `kubectl -n redwood scale deployment inference-runtime --replicas=14` and `trafficrouter promote-route eu -> dedicated-pool`.
emily: posting customer note: "We're investigating elevated error rates affecting EU traffic; mitigation underway."
devon: rollback request submitted: `POST /infra/cfg/rollbacks` -> 202 accepted. Watcher shows rollback applied to 80% nodes.
alex: metrics update: 5xx rate dropping from 7.9% -> 4.1% as rollback propagates. Latency still high on some requests.
maria: also seeing KV cache churn logs around same time but likely downstream. Opening ticket INF-5901 to correlate.
devon: restarted problematic node sidecars to clear stale connections: `kubectl rollout restart daemonset ingress-sidecar -n redwood --field-selector spec.nodeName=node-12` (rolling).
alex: smoke test: `curl -sS -D - https://eu-ingress.redwood.ai/health | head -n 1` -> `HTTP/2 200`
emily: CS updated again, adding note for customers informed and waiting for stability check.
ops-bot: PagerDuty note: incident acknowledged by alex at 03:05 UTC. Next escalation paused.
maria: watching 5xx% now at 0.7% in eu-west1; continuing to monitor for 30m.
devon: RCA preliminary: automated config rollout accidentally applied environment-specific templating error: units interpreted as "hundreds" -> clamp applied too aggressively. I'll prepare a PR to add validation and require a canary window.
alex: adding followups: 1) add a preflight diff check for rate-limiter changes; 2) add rollback shortcut for infra-cfg-manager; 3) increase canary sample size for infra configs touching connection limits.
emily: escalating to product impact channel for any enterprise customers.
maria: leaving notes for postmortem, will join RCA.
alex: marking PD incident PD-50902 as mitigated (manual). Will keep thread open for 1hr for stability. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident PD-50902 manually closed by alex at 03:12 UTC. Follow-up ticket assigned: INF-5902 (RCA & gating).
